items.title: What Is QUALCOMM (QCOM) Signaling With Its New AI PC OS Partnership?
items.summary: QUALCOMM (NasdaqGS:QCOM) is working with Kora Systems on a new Linux-based AI desktop operating system tuned for Snapdragon chips. Kora Systems, founded by Cyanogen co-founder Kirt McMaster, unveiled the AI focused desktop OS for Snapdragon powered PCs. The platform is built around on device AI workloads, aligning with Qualcomm's push into AI capable personal computers beyond smartphones. This new Kora Systems Linux AI OS for Snapdragon PCs is only one piece of what is changing for Qualcomm...

items.title: Apple Just Hit $5 Trillion. Its “Biggest Competition” Is a SpaceX Phone, Says Gene Munster
items.summary: Key TakeawaysApple closed above $350 for the first time on Monday, which took its market value back above $5 trillion. Gene Munster says Apple’s biggest competition is a SpaceX phone that Elon Musk has called “utterly false,” and SpaceX is already building a nationwide 5G network with Qualcomm.
